description: Crypto-related physical attacks, known as wrench attacks, have resulted in more than $30 million (roughly Rs. 286 crore) in stolen assets during the first half of 2026, according to Chainalysis. The blockchain analytics firm recorded 46 violent incidents involving kidnappings, home invasions and hostage situations, putting the year on track to surpass 2025's record losses. The report also highlighted growing concerns over data leaks and privacy risks that expose crypto holders to targeted attacks.
title: Crypto Wrench Attack Losses Surpass $30 Million in 2026, Says Chainalysis

description: JBL Live Buds 4 and Live Beam 4 have been launched in India.  The company claims that the JBL Live Buds 4 provide 32 hours of battery life with Bluetooth and ANC turned on and 40 hours of battery life with ANC turned off. On the other hand, the JBL Live Beam 4 offers 40 hours of battery life with ANC on and 48 hours of battery life with ANC off. 10 minutes of charge is claimed to offer 4 hours of audio playback. The charging case supports wireless charging, too. The JBL Live 4 models are currently available for purchase via the JBL India online store and other leading online retail channels.
title: JBL Live Buds 4 Launched in India With 10mm Dynamic Drivers, Live Beam 4 Tags Along: Price, Features

description: Nothing has announced that the Nothing Phone (4a), Phone (4a) Pro, and Phone (4b) will be available at discounted prices during the upcoming Flipkart Freedom Sale. The company has revealed the discounts and offers. The latest Nothing Phone (4b) will be available with a bank discount of up to Rs. 3,000 on credit card EMI transactions. Alternatively, buyers can get a bank discount of up to Rs. 2,625 on regular credit card payments. On top of this, the Flipkart Freedom Sale will offer an exchange bonus of up to Rs. 1,000, taking the effective price of the Nothing Phone (4b) to Rs. 30,999.
title: Flipkart Freedom Sale: Nothing Phone (4a) Series, Phone (4b) Discounts, Offers Announced

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale will begin on August 8 for all customers, and the e-commerce platform has highlighted deals on Amazon Echo smart speakers, Echo smart displays, and Fire TV streaming devices. The online marketplace has promised up to 35 percent off on Echo and Fire TV products. In addition to the general discounts, shoppers can avail UPI-based payment offers and exchange discounts on select models.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Deals on Amazon Echo Smart Speakers, Fire TV Streaming Devices

description: Western Union has partnered with stablecoin infrastructure platform Rain to launch Stablecard, a digital wallet with a Visa card that enables users to store, transfer and spend the dollar-backed USDPT stablecoin. Initially available in 37 countries, the service allows remittance recipients to receive funds directly into a stablecoin wallet and make payments through Visa's global merchant network. The company plans to expand the offering to over 60 countries this year.
title: Western Union Introduces Stablecoin Transfers Via Visa Network and Stablecard

description: A fresh leak has outlined the expected specifications of the iPhone 18 Pro Max, pointing to upgrades across the display, chipset, cameras, battery and connectivity. Separately, a new report claims Apple is working with suppliers to secure enough DRAM before the launch of the iPhone 18 series, amid broader memory supply constraints. Earlier reports also suggest the company is evaluating new memory suppliers and could increase RAM across the lineup to support additional Apple Intelligence features.
title: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Max Leak Reveals Key Specifications Amid DRAM Shortage Report

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 will begin on August 7. Ahead of the sale, Amazon has confirmed that home appliances will be offered with up to a 65 percent discount during the sale. Above the sale prices, shoppers can avail bank discounts, UPI-based discounts, exchange offers and other offers. Amazon has partnered with HDFC Bank to offer an additional discount of up to 10 percent.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Deals on Home Appliances Teased

description: Rockstar Games has announced that an extended look look for Grand Theft Auto 6 is coming later this month on Netflix. Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look will premiere on the streaming giant on August 27 at 3pm ET. The showcase will later launch on YouTube and the official GTA 6 website.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Get an Extended Look on Netflix on August 27, Rockstar Announces

description: The Asus Pad is now available for purchase in India through Flipkart, Asus eShop, ROG Stores, Reliance Digital and authorised retail partners. The tablet starts at 45,990 for the 8GB RAM + 128GB storage variant. It has a 12.2-inch 2.8K (1,840x2,800 pixels) OLED display. The Asus Pad runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 8300 chipset paired with 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. It features a 13-megapixel rear camera.
title: Asus Pad Goes on Sale in India With 2.8K OLED Display, Dimensity 8300 SoC: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers

description: The Amazon Great Freedom Sale in India is all set to begin tomorrow (Friday). The Independence Day-themed annual sale event is expected to bring discounts on a wide range of products, including smartphones, tablets, TVs, ACs, and other electronics. Ahead of the sale, the e-commerce giant has announced a range of tablet deals. Shoppers will be able to purchase tablets from brands like Samsung, OnePlus, Lenovo, and Xiaomi at considerably lower prices than their usual market rates.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: Top Deals on Xiaomi Pad 7, OnePlus Pad 2, Redmi Pad 2 and More

description: Vivo S2 has been launched in India, marking the return of the Vivo S series in the country after a hiatus of seven years. The smartphone industry has transformed quite a bit, and so has the new V series phone, which now comes with a significantly higher price tag. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, the Vivo S2 offers enough performance to meet the needs of most users and some power users. Its battery can easily last a day. However, the impressive standby battery life makes it stand out. The innovative, iconic design of the phone sets it apart from the competition.
title: Vivo S2 Review: A Familiar Name Returns With a Curved Display

description: Amazon has revealed discounts on several smart TVs before the Great Freedom Sale begins on August 7. Confirmed offers include selected Xiaomi, Samsung, Sony, LG and TCL models across 43-inch, 55-inch and 65-inch screen sizes. Buyers can also avail of eligible bank discounts and EMI offers to lower the effective purchase price further. In addition to price cuts, Amazon is offering benefits such as Free Delivery on the first order, Pay on Delivery and Easy Returns on eligible purchases during the sale.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Smart TVs From Samsung, TCL, Xiaomi and More Revealed

description: European regulators have warned crypto users about a rise in impersonation scams following the implementation of the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework. Fraudsters are reportedly posing as financial watchdogs and licensed crypto firms to deceive users of exchanges that failed to secure MiCA authorisation. Authorities have urged investors to verify communications carefully as thousands of unlicensed crypto businesses are expected to exit the European market under the new regulatory regime.
title: EU Regulators Warn Crypto Users of Impersonation Scams During MiCA Transition

description: Flipkart's dedicated microsite for the Freedom Sale reveals the sale prices of Nothing and Oppo smartphones ahead of the sale. The Nothing Phone 4a will be available for Rs. 37,999. EMI offers will start at Rs. 4,222 per month. The Phone 4a Pro is confirmed to be priced at Rs. 43,999. Buyers can avail no-cost EMI offers during the sale.
title: Flipkart Freedom Sale: Nothing Phone 4a Series, Reno 15 Series, More to Be Offered at a Discount

description: Amazon has announced discounts on several smartphones priced below Rs. 40,000 ahead of its Great Freedom Sale, which begins on August 7. Confirmed offers include devices from OnePlus, Samsung, Redmi and iQOO, with some prices reflecting bank discounts and coupon benefits. Shoppers can further reduce costs through eligible bank offers, while additional sale benefits include Free Delivery on the first order, Pay on Delivery and Easy Returns. Exchange offers may also lower the effective purchase price.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Smartphone Deals Under Rs. 40,000 Revealed

description: Anthropic has started hiring Research Engineers for its Chip Design RL team at the company’s San Francisco and New York City offices, seemingly confirming the company's plans to foray into designing custom AI chips in-house. An Anthropic spokesperson reportedly confirmed the development to a publication. The tech firm will reportedly co-design hardware and models, which is said to enable the Claude models to “run faster and more efficiently” at the scale required by Anthropic’s customers.
title: Anthropic Could Build Custom AI Chips for Claude Models, Job Listing Suggests
Why Now Is the Smartest Time to Buy a Galaxy Tab S Tablet

description: Bitcoin remained range-bound on Thursday as steady spot ETF inflows helped offset profit-taking by long-term holders. Analysts said institutional demand remains supportive, while broader macroeconomic conditions and liquidity indicators will determine whether the cryptocurrency can break out of its recent trading range.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $65,000 as ETF Inflows Help Offset Profit-Taking

description: There has been no new update on Grand Theft Auto 6 since pre-orders for the game went live in late June. And it has been over a year since the game's second trailer was released. But speculation around a third trailer and gameplay reveal has intensified ahead of Take-Two's earnings call this week.
title: GTA 6 Third Trailer and Gameplay Speculation Intensifies Ahead of Take-Two Earnings Call

description: HP OmniPad 12 is now available for purchase in India. It was launched in the country in May as the company's first tablet designed specifically for the Indian market. It sports a 12-inch 2K display with a 90Hz refresh rate. The tablet is powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon processor, coupled with 8GB of RAM and support for expandable storage of up to 1TB via a microSD card. It comes with a detachable keyboard and runs on Android 16.
title: HP OmniPad 12 Goes on Sale in India With Snapdragon Chip, Detachable Keyboard

description: Sony has expanded the WH-1000XM6 lineup in India by introducing a new Olive Grey finish. The headphones retain the same hardware and features as the existing variants, including adaptive noise cancellation powered by the QN3 processor, support for high-resolution audio formats, Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and Multipoint pairing. The latest colour option is priced at Rs. 39,990 and will initially be sold through Amazon, taking the total number of available finishes for the flagship headphones to six.
title: Sony WH-1000XM6 Now Available in Olive Grey Colour Variant in India: Price, Availability, Features

description: Redmi 17 5G has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company's budget lineup. The handset is currently on sale in China via the Xiaomi online store. The Redmi 17 5G is offered in Cold Mist Blue, Feather Mist White, and Star Rock Black (translated from Chinese) colour options. The Redmi 17 5G is a dual-SIM smartphone. It ships with Xiaomi’s latest Android 16-based HyperOS 3. The handset sports a 6.9-inch HD (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen, which delivers up to 120Hz refresh rate, 240Hz touch sampling rate, and up to 800 nits peak brightness.
title: Redmi 17 5G Launched With 6,300mAh Battery, 6.9-Inch HD Display: Price, Specifications

description: Motorola has started rolling out the Android 17 beta update to Motorola Signature units that were already enrolled in Motorola's Android 17 beta programme, according to a report. The Android 17 beta update for the Motorola Signature reportedly brings the same features and changes as the version users received on the Motorola Edge 60 Pro. The update reportedly introduces a dynamic island-like feature, new quick tiles with the ability to resize them, along with fresh icons for Wi-Fi, cellular signal strength, and battery percentage. Additionally, it is said to offer a new volume interface, new customisation options, a redesigned settings menu, and enhanced haptics.
title: Motorola Signature Starts Receiving Android 17 Beta Update With Redesigned App Icons, New Features: Report

description: Vivo S2 was launched in India on Thursday as the first model in the S-lineup in nearly seven years. The handset is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, coupled with 8GB of RAM. It sports a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The Vivo S2 is equipped with a 50-megapixel dual rear camera setup. It runs on OriginOS 6 out of the box and packs a 7,050mAh battery.
title: Vivo S2 Launched in India With Dimensity 7360-Turbo Chipset, 7,050mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung has started its The Big Bespoke AI Fest campaign in India with promotional offers on selected AI-powered home appliances until August 15. Buyers can avail of cashback, extended warranty benefits through Samsung Care+, and finance options across eligible Bespoke AI refrigerators, washing machines, and washer-dryer combinations. The company is also offering zero down payment plans, a one EMI benefit on a selected washer-dryer model, and low-cost monthly instalments. The offers are available through Samsung's official and partner sales channels.
title: Samsung Unveils The Big Bespoke AI Fest in India Ahead of Independence Day: Offers, Benefits

description: Redmi Note 17 5G has been launched in India. The new smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in India on August 12 via Amazon and the Xiaomi India online store. The Redmi Note 17 5G is offered in Arctic Blue, Dark Night, and Starlight Purple colour options. The Redmi Note 17 5G is a dual-SIM smartphone that ships with Xiaomi’s latest HyperOS 3, which is based on Android 16. The Xiaomi sub-brand promises four years of OS upgrades and six years of security patches for the new smartphone. It features a Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, paired with an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Redmi Note 17 5G Launched in India With 8,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE will be available at Rs. 47,999 during the upcoming Flipkart Freedom Sale. Interested users can buy the handset with EMI offers starting at Rs. 8,333 per month. The Galaxy S25 FE was launched in India last year with a starting price tag of Rs. 59,999. The standard Galaxy S25 is also confirmed to be discounted in the sale. It will be offered for a starting price of Rs. 57,999, instead of the actual price of Rs. 74,999.
title: Flipkart Freedom Sale: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE Confirmed to Be Available at a Discounted Price

description: Google has long been rumoured to be foraying into the Bluetooth tracker market. According to the rumour mill, the Mountain View-based tech giant could finally announce its first device, ubiquitously known as the Pixel Tag, at the Made by Google event, which is scheduled for next week. Ahead of its anticipated debut, its European pricing and availability details have been leaked. The purported Pixel Tag is expected to compete directly with Apple's AirTag, and reports suggest it could be priced similarly.
title: Google Pixel Tag European Pricing, Launch Date Reportedly Leaked Ahead of Made by Google Event

description: A leaked HyperOS 4 roadmap has outlined Xiaomi's possible beta testing schedule in China, including dates for registrations, the launch event and the first beta rollout. The company has yet to confirm the timeline, which could change before release. HyperOS 4 is expected to be based on Android 17 and may introduce a redesigned interface, new AI-powered capabilities, system animation upgrades, and performance improvements. The initial beta release is also expected to remain limited to selected devices in China.
title: Xiaomi HyperOS 4 Leak Hints at Beta Rollout Timeline and New Features

description: Vivo V80 Lite 5G surfaced on the Google Play Supported Devices List with the model numbers V2576, V2643, and V2644. The listing doesn't reveal any specifications of the phone besides the model number and moniker, but it indicates that the launch is imminent. It is speculated to come with a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate, as well as a MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo processor.
title: Vivo V80 Lite 5G Spotted on Google Play Supported Devices Listing; Launch Seems Imminent

description: OnePlus has had a busy year in India. Since January, the brand has pushed out a steady stream of launches, starting with the Nord 6, Nord CE 6 and Nord CE 6 Lite in the smartphone lineup, and on the IoT side, the OnePlus Pad Lite, Pad Go 2 and Pad 4 tablets alongside the Nord Buds 4 and Nord Buds 4 Pro. For a company reportedly plotting a global retreat, OnePlus is launching an awful lot of phones.
title: "Our Focus Has Remained Unchanged": OnePlus India Responds to Exit Speculation With Growth Numbers

description: Activision and Treyarch release Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2 ports on PS4 and PS5 on July 9. In less than a month, the two games are reportedly among the best-selling titles of 2026. According to an analyst's estimates, Black Ops 2 has sold 8.2 million copies, while Black Ops has sold 3 million units on PS4 and PS5.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2 PlayStation Ports Reportedly Among Best-Selling Games of 2026

description: Apple introduced iCloud Private Relay in 2021 as a new privacy service that allows users to connect to and browse the Web more securely and privately. However, security researchers say that it may not be able to fully protect users' IP addresses under certain circumstances. According to a report, the issue reportedly stems from multiple vulnerabilities in WebKit, potentially allowing websites to learn a user's real IP address even when iCloud Private Relay is enabled.
title: Apple’s iCloud Private Relay May Expose Users' Real IP Addresses Due to WebKit Flaws: Report

description: The Poco M8 Power, OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite and Moto G77 Power cater to buyers seeking long battery life and 5G connectivity in the mid-range segment. While the Poco handset leads with its 8,000mAh battery and AMOLED display, the OnePlus model offers faster storage and a higher refresh rate panel. The Moto G77 Power differentiates itself with an ultrawide rear camera and a higher-resolution selfie shooter. Here's a closer look at how the three smartphones stack up.
title: Poco M8 Power vs OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite vs Moto G77 Power: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Realme 16x 5G will be launched in India on August 12 at 12 pm IST. The company has confirmed that the handset will go on sale in India via Flipkart. It will be offered in Blooming Brown and Blooming Silver colour options. The company claims that the handset will ship with an IP65 rating for dust and water resistance and MIL-STD-810H certification for durability. Moreover, the Realme 16x 5G is confirmed to be equipped with an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, which is built on a 6nm process. Realme has confirmed that the Realme 16x 5G will be backed by a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Realme 16x 5G Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India and Specifications

description: Apple’s first foldable iPhone is finally expected to debut this year alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to confirm the details, a new report suggests that the purported handset could have a significant impact on the foldable smartphone market. Samsung is reported to maintain its leadership position, but Apple’s foray into this segment could lead to an increase in foldable smartphone shipments by 20 percent, with wider adoption of book-style foldables also playing a key factor.
title: iPhone Ultra to Fuel 20 Percent Growth in Foldable Smartphone Shipments This Year: Report
